description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Swiftgear Drake.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Swiftgear Drake.
When the Swiftgear Drake token enters the batlefield, it triggers, putting Kiki-Jiki on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Kiki-Jiki into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.
